values.note: Every standard site has individual water and electric hookups; the park does not state the amperage.

hookups.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/lake-hartwell/camping ('109 paved sites with individual water and electrical hook-ups'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 109 paved water/electric sites, many with shoreline access to Lake Hartwell, plus 13 walk-in tent sites with tent pads. 'Many sites accommodate RVs up to 40 feet.' One trailer/RV and one tent per site, two vehicles.

sites.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/lake-hartwell/camping ('Standard Sites with Elec. & Water: 109 paved sites'; 'Many sites accommodate RVs up to 40 feet'; '13 walk-in tent sites include tent pads') + reservation policies on https://reserve.southcarolinaparks.com/lake-hartwell/campsites, read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/lake-hartwell/camping ('All sites are convenient to hot showers and restrooms'; 'Dump Station: Yes'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Booked on South Carolina State Parks' own reservation site or 1-866-345-7275, up to 13 months ahead. 'Camping reservations must be made for a minimum of two nights'; per the --AWH note, a single night can be booked by calling the park within a week of arrival. Maximum 14 nights per site (cumulative up to 42 of 49). Same-day reservations go through the park (864-972-3352). Check-in 2 pm, check-out noon.

booking.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/lake-hartwell/camping ('Camping reservations must be made for a minimum of two nights'; same-day via the park) + https://reserve.southcarolinaparks.com/lake-hartwell/campsites (policies: 'Reservations may be made up to 13 months in advance', 'Minimum length of stay is 2 nights', 'Maximum length of stay is 14 nights per site', check-in 2:00 p.m., check-out 12:00 p.m.), read 2026-10-21; single-night waiver from the entry's --AWH note

summary: Confirmed reservable on SC's own site with the 13-month window and 2-night minimum (now on the entry with the AWH phone waiver). Added water hookups (amperage not stated), 109 paved RV sites up to 40 ft, showers, dump, 14-night max. Fees left as read 2026-10-12. Note kept. Not stated: amps, sewer, campground season, pull-throughs, laundry.
